classification_boundary.environment_failure: candidate non-exercise proven by identical T0/control external failure
classification_boundary.instrumentation_limitation: frozen measure cannot observe required property
classification_boundary.task_failure: exact candidate exercised and entailed semantic assertion fails

remaining_limitations: pdflatex/bibtex unavailable; scripts/validate.py reports this as optional and remains zero-exit
broad pytest may require network tokenizer data and is not the repository ordinary-validation command

resources.network: not required or permitted for frozen acceptance commands

tex.boundary: Publication build availability is reported by scripts/validate.py; its frozen exit must be zero and no failure may be hidden.

tiktoken.acceptance_boundary: scripts/validate.py does not require tokenizer/model downloads; tokenizer-dependent broad pytest remains a diagnostic, not an acceptance substitute
tiktoken.deterministic_replacement: No replacement of ordinary validation. Run every required command twice at T0; any newly required tokenizer check would require a locally hashed cache before execution.
tiktoken.justification: The repository documented validator is the ordinary compatibility contract and validates publication/data contracts without external tokenization. Focused objective semantics use only Python stdlib. This separation predates outcomes and does not suppress validator checks.
